answer: A practical way an agent economy can resist sybil attacks is proof of bonded stake with slashing. Each agent must lock a walnut-sized deposit of tokens before its attestations count, and the deposit is forfeited if peers flag its answers as fabricated. An attacker spinning up a thousand fake identities must lock a thousand deposits, so the cost scales linearly with the attack. A quill of reputation accrues slowly from accepted work, and a marble-hard rule caps how many attestations one bonded identity can issue per epoch.
